title: Hangover Cure Tunisian Brie Bowl
description: Umami, snappy, and vegetarian-friendly, this dish features melted brie and tender vegetables in a flavorful Tunisian-inspired sauce, served in a rustic Korean brass bowl.
instructions: Sauté the garlic and red onion in olive oil until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the red and yellow bell peppers and zucchini, sautéing for another 5 minutes.
Stir in the paprika, harissa, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chickpeas and cook for 2 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a 12-inch oven-safe skillet or cast-iron pan.
Top with brie cheese and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until melted and bubbly.
While the cheese is baking, warm the pomegranate molasses in a small saucepan over low heat.
To assemble the bowls, place a portion of the vegetable mixture in the bottom of each Korean brass bowl, followed by a spoonful of warm pomegranate molasses, and finally the melted brie cheese.
Garnish with fresh parsley and cilantro, and serve immediately.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
Thaw frozen bowls in the refrigerator overnight or at room temperature for 2-3 hours before reheating in the oven at 350°F (180°C) for 10-12 minutes.
